basic_info.description: Nestled in Miraloma Park, this Mediterranean-style home was thoughtfully updated in 2018-19. On the main level, natural light pours in through large windows and 2 skylights. Hardwood floors flow throughout the elegant dining room and living room into the chef's kitchen, which boasts custom cabinets, stainless steel, and Thermador appliances. Large patio doors walk out onto the deck, perfect for entertaining. In addition to 1 bedroom and 1 bath on the main level, the lower level offers 3 bedrooms and 2 baths, including the spacious master suite. With radiant under-floor heating, energy efficient LED lighting, an electric upgrade enabled for a 90 Amp electric car charger, and a smart home keyless entry system, this home has been updated to perfectly suit modern living. One car parking and a prime location ensure easy access to Glen Park Bart, 280 and 101 freeways, Mt. Davidson Park, Twin Peaks, & West Portal village.
